desc: Reduce strong connectivity to the prefix-cut coverage condition and the first-return recurrence.
Implement first-return recurrence h_i = (W_i! − Σ_{j<i} h_j (W_i−B_j)!)·inv(T_i!) with CDQ.
Integrate range-restricted numpy-NTT convolutions into CDQ.
Confirm 3 public samples produce 1 / 0 / 240792 (direct-DP path only, M≤800).
Force CDQ path (direct-DP threshold=0) and stress-test vs O(N^2) reference: all balanced N≤8, random N=50/200/1000, (BW)^N, B W^{N-1} B^{N-1} W; report first mismatch.
If CDQ mismatch found, instrument the merge to dump accum[] at base cases and compare term-by-term with the recurrence to localize the bug.
Benchmark N=2e5 worst cases (random, B^N W^N, (BW)^N, B W^{N-1} B^{N-1} W) and record wall time; ensure it fits the time limit.
Fallback if CDQ remains buggy or too slow: adopt a simpler/safer approach (different reduction or fixless tier) rather than polishing a stuck implementation.
